comment: US federal self-employment tax parameters. The rates, the 92.35% factor and the $400 threshold are statute and do not drift by year; the Social Security wage base does, and is listed per year with its source. A year not listed is UNKNOWN on purpose: never carry last year's base forward.
source: IRC sections 1401, 1402(a) and 6017; SSA contribution and benefit base history, ssa.gov/oact/cola/cbb.html, read September 2026

wageBases.source: SSA 2025 COLA fact sheet, ssa.gov/news/en/cola/factsheets/2025.html: maximum taxable earnings 168,600 for 2024
SSA 2025 COLA fact sheet, ssa.gov/news/en/cola/factsheets/2025.html: maximum taxable earnings 176,100 for 2025
SSA press release 2025-10-24 and contribution-and-benefit-base page ssa.gov/oact/cola/cbb.html: maximum taxable earnings 184,500 for 2026

notes: Additional Medicare Tax (0.9% above household thresholds, IRC section 3101(b)(2)) is deliberately NOT computed: it depends on household income the books of one entity do not hold.
Half of the SE tax is deductible above the line (IRC section 164(f)); the worksheet subtracts it before applying the person's chosen marginal rate.
